name: Kurz Explainer
tagline: BusyBee3333/animated-explainer-skills: a Kurzgesagt-style world in parallax layers, a flying host that points and taps, quantities as little characters. (Georgia → Fraunces, Nunito → Jost: the bundled faces.)

motion.direction: gsap-explainer method. ONE `explainerWorld` behind the whole film (the world that fits the topic: space, earth, city, ocean, cell, lab), its host flying to a new perch on each beat and pointing (`point`) at what is being said, tapping (`tap`) a number as it lands, `wow` on the payoff, `think` on the question. Quantities are little characters, not dots: a `crowd` whose highlight lands on the spoken number ("1 in 4" = count 20, highlight 5). Titles in Fraunces (serif, sentence case) on the cream field; Caveat-style hand notes are not used. Motion: drops with a bounce (back-out pops, stagger 0.09 s), stamp slams from scale 2.6 rotated −14° on verdicts, push-ins 1.02–1.05 on payoffs, anticipation before every slam. First beat by 0.5 s; no dead stretch longer than 4 s. Never two texts on top of each other (the host avoids headlines).
